name: smiling-girl-classroom
image_purpose: classroom lifestyle and smart-casual outfit reference

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic classroom candid portrait of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair, brown eyes, natural makeup, and a gentle confident smile, crouching beside a desk while holding colorful whiteboard markers.
prompt.composition_elements: Low-to-mid angle 4:5 smartphone framing, white blouse, secure black knee-length skirt, black closed-toe shoes, classroom desks, green chalkboard with generic math diagrams, and teacher podium.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even indoor daylight, natural skin tones, gentle shadows, calm academic setting.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone photography, 26mm equivalent, portrait 4:5, sharp subject, moderate depth of field, minimal grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair crouches beside a classroom desk, smiling softly while holding colorful whiteboard markers. She wears a white blouse, secure black knee-length skirt, and closed-toe shoes. Include desks, green chalkboard with generic math diagrams, podium, soft indoor light, and natural candid realism. No private student data or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted anatomy, blurry face, heavy retouching, private school data, unreadable personal text, watermark, public figure likeness.
